en: The image shows a historical street scene in a European town, featuring several prominent buildings. The central building is labeled 'Zum Kretscham,' suggesting it is a hotel or inn. There is also signage for 'F. Ernst Paul jr.' on another building. The postcard has German text in the top left corner and shows a war memorial (Kriegerdenkmal) in front of the hotel. The overall style and architecture suggest an early 20th-century period.
